causeAndRepair.demonstratedCause: Enter on focused Status implicitly submitted the editor, and Escape from a focused Status/Priority select while it matched :open propagated as modal cancellation.
causeAndRepair.repair: The shared dialog interaction boundary prevents implicit Enter submission while opening a closed single-select, and consumes modal cancellation only for a focused select that actually matches :open before blur/refocus with preventScroll.
causeAndRepair.preserved: Native select commit and keyboard behavior, selected values, encrypted drafts/retry/discard, ordinary Escape, close-button and submit paths, active scroll holds/anchors and preventScroll focus restoration.
causeAndRepair.limit: The owner report did not identify an exact control, browser, device or input trace. Playwright cannot select a macOS native popup option through physical input, so the original pointer-option symptom is not claimed reproduced or fixed directly. The click fallback is programmatic within user activation, not a trusted native click.
